messages:
alexa: heads-up — quick async question about request-level priority when a request includes both region_hint and variant/model_pin. which wins today? we have a canary that pins to a cheaper variant but the region preference is different and i'm worried about cross-region egress during rollout. :thinking_face:

jamal: short answer: runtime currently prefers explicit model_pin/variant over region_hint for served_model selection, then tries to satisfy region. but there are edgecases where fallback routing will move region before switching variant (can be surprising).

marta: that sounds risky for our Dedicated customers. do we have a deterministic contract we can document? need to know for the rollout playbook.

sophia: agree we should be explicit. current algorithm (high level):
1) if request.model_pin present -> attempt to route to that model variant (served_model) in any compatible region/tier
2) respect region_hint if that region has capacity for pinned variant; otherwise use fallback region according to region routing policy
3) if pinned variant unavailable -> apply fallback variants in order (model_hint list) and then try region again

alexa: can you paste the sample request shape so product folks understand the ambiguity?

jamal: sure — example we saw causing confusion:
```json
{
  "model_pin": "rw-llm-v1-quant8",
  "model_hint": ["rw-llm-v1-quant4", "rw-llm-v1-fp16"],
  "region_hint": "eu-west-1",
  "tier": "standard",
  "inputs": "..."
}
```

jamal: in this case current behavior: try rw-llm-v1-quant8 anywhere; prefer eu-west-1 if available; if not, pick next region with capacity. only if quant8 unavailable everywhere we move to quant4. so model selection > region preference, but we still try to honor region when possible.

marta: hmm that means a customer with strict EU data residency who pins a variant that only exists in us-east could leak across regions. we need a way to express "must_stay_in_region" or at least fail fast.

sophia: we have an internal flag `region_strict: true` planned for Private/Dedicated next quarter. behavior would be: if region_strict and region_hint specified then fail with 409 or return served_model=null + reason instead of crossing regions. we can expose a soft option earlier `prefer_region` that won't fail but will prefer fallbacks within region first.

alexa: for the API contract doc, we should spell out these options and the HTTP semantics. can we propose return shapes for when we can't honor both? e.g., served_model field + reason codes?

priyal: proposal: add fields in response header/body:
- served_model: string|null
- served_model_resolution: one of ["pinned_in_region","pinned_cross_region","fallback_variant","failed_region_strict"]
- served_model_reason: free text (short)

devex-bot: docs snippet: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/model-routing#resolution-codes (draft) :link: (will publish after PR)

jamal: +1 to explicit resolution codes. for backward compatibility we should default to current behavior when these fields are absent. new fields are additive. clients that parse served_model should handle null gracefully.

marta: action items:
- runtime: add `served_model_resolution` enum and ensure determinism (sophia/jamal)
- api: update contract and error codes for region_strict (marta)
- devex: add a one-pager and quick sample for customers (priyal/devex-bot)

sophia: timeline: can implement resolution codes + soft `prefer_region` in 2 weeks. region_strict that fails with 409 needs product approval and will be queued for next sprint after design doc.

alexa: thanks — can the runtime team post a short compatibility note about existing clients that expect served_model always present? some clients assume served_model string is non-null.

jamal: will do. note: existing clients should get served_model as before in most cases; only edgecases where pin unreachable + region_strict may change behavior. we'll add migration notes and a library helper to fallback to older semantics.

marta: excellent. tagging this thread for the rollout doc. @devex-bot can you create the doc stub and link here? :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Created doc stub: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/rollouts/model-priority-region (assigned to priyal, marta)

alexa: perfect — thanks all. I'll leave this thread open for async followups. :eyes:
